notes.title: Patch 1.3.6
notes.content:
Stability fixes!

 Fixed issue with game unable to launch on Beta clients.
 Fixed rare crash caused by dying with lightning weapon deployed.
 Disabled VSync for now to help compatibility issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.5
notes.content:
Updated for Steam Controllers!

Steam Controllers now fully supported, allowing ultra precise analog movements. Customize the basic profile in big picture mode!

Joysticks now use full analog input.
Angular movement calculations improved.
Main menu and customization screens accessible with joystick.
Deadzones adjusted.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
Weapon Updates:

Secondary weapons now have additional scaling effects for late game effectiveness!
New scaling effects of each weapon are as follows:

 Rainbow Cannon: Size
 Gatling Gun: Spread
 Drones: Duration
 Static Generator: Arcs


Settings:

 Added option to toggle VSync.
 Added option to reduce particle effects. (Most notably the smoke!)
 Tied anti-aliasing to quality setting.


General Fixes:

 Screenshots now work properly!
 Fixed audio cutting out at high laser levels.
 File structure improved. SSDs rejoice!
